component.name: Indeks
component.summary: Find, organize and annotate documents wherever they are stored

description.p: Indeks keeps track of your documents without taking them away from where they are. It indexes folders on this computer, on external drives and on servers, and makes their files findable by name, by the text inside them and by the text recognized in images and scans.

ul.li: Search file names, document text, notes and text recognized by OCR, with filters for tags, groups, types, dates and more
An inbox for documents that still need to be filed, plus groups, tags, saved searches and rules to keep order
Previews for plain and formatted text, PDF documents, images, exported e-mails and Obsidian canvases
Notes on every document and freehand drawing on images and PDF pages
Originals are never modified: editing and drawing happen on a copy kept by Indeks
Documents on unplugged drives and unreachable servers stay searchable
Every function is available from the command bar with Ctrl+Alt+I
“Send to Indeks” for folders in the context menu of the Dolphin file manager

description.p: The Flatpak uses the icon theme of the desktop, and the manual says how to back up.

ul.li: The Flatpak drew the icons of Breeze where the icon theme of the desktop came with a global theme; it now draws those of your theme
The manual has a section on backing up a database and bringing it back, and names the folder of the Flatpak wherever it names the one of the local database

description.p: The sidebar and the side panel slide in and out.

ul.li: Shown and hidden, the sidebar and the side panel slide at their edges of the window, and the middle of the window follows

description.p: To-dos with a deadline can be shown in the calendar.

ul.li: The to-dos of a database that have a deadline are kept as a calendar file, each on the day it is due; a to-do that is done leaves the calendar
Where the calendar of KDE is installed, the to-dos are added to it, so that KOrganizer, Merkuro and the calendar of the clock in the panel show them
Turned on under Settings, To-Do List, for each database

description.p: Mends a standstill of the window.

ul.li: When Indeks was started with the documents shown as thumbnails, the first switch to the list could make the window stand still for minutes where many thousands of documents were listed, in an opened mailbox for instance

description.p: Documents are found by what they look like, shown as thumbnails and searched inside; the window can be arranged; large databases open without a wait.

ul.li: “Find Similar-Looking Documents” lists the PDFs and pictures that look like the selected one: pages with the same letterhead or logo, whatever the files are called
The documents can be shown as thumbnails in a grid, with a bar above them for sorting, size and the choice between list and grid
A Find tab in the side panel searches inside the document that is shown (Ctrl+D)
The tabs of the sidebar and the side panel can be dragged to either side and split into an upper and a lower area; Ctrl+B and Ctrl+Shift+B show and hide the two
Tables in the preview can be sorted by a column, and columns hidden; plain text files that are Markdown or tables are shown as such
Saved searches are put together from filters, like the conditions of a rule
Lists and the numbers of the sidebar are worked out in the background, so a large database opens at once
Scripts run in the Flatpak

description.p: Rules and scripts have a tab of their own, the toolbar can be arranged as a whole, and what you copied can become a document.

ul.li: The sidebar has two tabs, Database and Automation: rules and scripts are listed in the middle of the window and changed where the preview is, instead of in dialogs
“New Document from Clipboard…” (Ctrl+Shift+V) makes a document of copied text or a copied picture
Websites: a copied web address becomes a document that opens the page in the browser; kind:website finds them
The preview can stand beside the list instead of below it, for wide screens
The search field and the buttons beside it can be moved and removed like every other toolbar button, and entries in the toolbar settings are dragged into place

description.p: Documents can be linked to one another.

ul.li: “Manage Linked Documents…” (Ctrl+L), in the context menu and in the Information tab, shows the documents a document is linked to and finds others to link
“Link Selected Documents” links several documents with one another at once
The search term is:linked finds the documents that have links
In a rule, filter choices that no document matches yet can be chosen, so a rule can be kept to the inbox while the inbox is empty
Opening a database with this version brings it up to date; version 0.2.0 and older cannot open it afterwards

description.p: Files now come into Indeks through indexed folders only, and databases are chosen with more care.

ul.li: A new installation asks whether to start a new database or to open one that exists
“Add Database…” opens a database by its file index.sqlite; “New Database…” starts one and warns when the folder is not empty
Indeks marks its index files as its own and leaves a file of that name from another program untouched
Single files can no longer be added: “Add Files…” is gone, and “Send to Indeks” in Dolphin is for folders
“Add Indexed Folder…” is on Ctrl+O

description.p: The first release: indexing in place, search, groups, tags and rules, previews of many kinds of documents, notes and drawing, a to-do list, scripts, and a manual.
